channel.title: Task Focus Blog
channel.description: Practical guides to starting tasks, blocking distracting apps on iPhone, and finishing one thing at a time.

item.title: How to Stop Opening Distracting Apps While You Work on iPhone
item.description: Silencing notifications isn’t enough. Learn how to quiet your iPhone with Focus, name one task, and pause the apps you open out of habit until it’s done.
item.dc:creator: Sascha Thiele

item.title: Pomodoro or Task-Based Focus: How to Choose a Stopping Point
item.description: Pomodoro ends on the clock; task-based focus ends when the work is done. A fair comparison of both, with research on breaks and a simple way to choose.
item.dc:creator: Sascha Thiele

item.title: How to Start a Task When You Keep Putting It Off
item.description: Turn a vague goal into a first action and a clear moment to begin. A practical guide to if-then planning, with examples for study, work, and home.
item.dc:creator: Sascha Thiele

item.title: Why You Keep Thinking About the Last Task
item.description: Attention residue explains why a quick check costs more than it seems. What the research says, and a three-line return note that makes switching easier.
item.dc:creator: Sascha Thiele

item.title: Why Your To-Do List Never Fits Your Day
item.description: Separate your task inventory from today’s commitment, estimate from past experience, and plan a day that fits. With a worked example and an evening check.
item.dc:creator: Sascha Thiele
